observation.source_interface: MNCS Control system_status and connected MNCS Environment MCP tool

outcome.control_runtime: The Control runtime and checked-out source report the same merged revision; Control reports no process restart required.
outcome.interpretation: The remaining mismatch is not explained by a stale Control server process. Control explicitly reports that its status cannot observe the caller's captured MCP tool surface. The current evidence does not distinguish a stale caller registration from another adapter boundary.
outcome.analysis_limit: The caller-side adapter revision and registration refresh state are unavailable through the exposed status interface.

pressure_hypothesis.title: A caller cannot reliably reselect an authenticated session after losing local context
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Control LocalEnvironmentMCP continuation and project-session selection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: Control's current process reports the merged source revision, but the connected Environment tool still rejects the exact session selector.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Refresh or identify the caller-side Environment adapter that owns the captured operation argument contract, then repeat the exact-session readback through that same client.
